draft-only.label: Draft-Only
draft-only.description: May observe, advise, and write drafts to a staging queue. May not publish, spend, or change anything live.

not-deployed.label: Not Deployed
not-deployed.description: Registered but not deployed. No access of any kind.

read-only-advisory.label: Read-Only Advisory
read-only-advisory.description: May observe and advise. May not change anything.

rules: Each operator is bound to exactly one environment. No cross-environment access.
An operator may only perform actions its current mode allows.
Every authorization decision is recorded in an append-only audit log.
A mode change is never self-approved. A request is recorded as pending; only the owner can approve it.
Fail closed, always. Unknown operators, environments, actions, modes, malformed input, and unexpected errors all deny.
